title: What {A} does is data, step 3: the plugin list by id, out of App.tsx
body:
Step 3 of the refactor (after #72–#74). Every plugin is now listed once, by a stable id, in `src/game/plugins/index.ts` (`createIsland`), in draw and {A} order. App.tsx hands `pluginList(island)` to `CityGame` and names no plugin itself, so **a new character is one line there and doesn't touch App.tsx**.

- **Ids are names:** `?open=crow` now opens the snack crow (that plugin's own target, via `targetsOf`) instead of whichever street crow matched by name. Dev hooks are generated as `window.__<id>`; all the old names (`__race`, `__maze`, `__boxing`…) are kept, plus `__cup`, `__seal`, `__arcadeDoor`.
- **Guard:** `src/game/onInteract.test.ts` now also fails if App.tsx imports a plugin (an `import type` is fine), and says where to add it. Checked that it fails when it should.
- **Docs:** CLAUDE.md (convention 7, where things live, Verifying), `src/game/CLAUDE.md`, `src/ui/CLAUDE.md`, `openLink.ts`.
- App.tsx: 642 → 612 lines.

Verified: 463 tests (new `src/game/plugins/index.test.ts`: order, ids, `?solo`, every plugin that has targets is an Actor, the snack crow and not a street crow). Build and smoke pass, and smoke has a new check that `?open=crow` offers "Share a carrot". The dev hooks were checked in Chrome.

Mike: heads-up only. Nothing you'd see changes. If you add a character, it goes in `createIsland`.

## Story

Idea: Finish the "what {A} does is data" refactor: every character is listed by name in one place, so adding one never touches the app's wiring.
Where: open:crow
Asked vs made: Asked for step 3 of the refactor. Made the plugin list by id, fixed `?open=crow`, and added a guard.
Mike:
Note: Nothing on the island looks different. The crow link now finds the snack crow.
